parent_channels.name: Making Things Knowable

subchannels.name: Teaching, Reading, and Inscription
subchannels.scene_or_process: A knowledgeable source gathers words, teaches a human recipient, and fixes instruction with a prepared writing implement.
subchannels.active_motifs: gathered recitation `ق ر ء:B001/m01`; divinely grounded learning `ر ب ب:B003/m01`; acquired knowledge `ع ل م:B001/m01`; writing stylus `ق ل م:B003/m01`; human learner `ء ن س:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Recitation supplies the ordered verbal material, teaching transfers it, and the pared stylus gives it durable form. The human figure is both the object of creation and the recipient whose prior lack is changed into knowledge.

subchannels.name: Eye, Pupil, and Sustained Regard
subchannels.scene_or_process: Detection begins with the eye, focuses through the dark pupil, and can settle into a prolonged, quiet gaze.
subchannels.active_motifs: visual perception `ر ء ي:B001/m01`; sensory detection `ء ن س:B002/m01`; dark pupil `ء ن س:B005/m01`; sustained gaze `س ج د:B005/m01`; dark-red or black tinge `س ف ع:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The scene is an optical mechanism rather than a generic cognition cluster: an object is detected, received in the pupil, and held under an unbroken gaze. The chromatic branch sharpens the concrete blackness through which sight is imagined.

subchannels.name: Deliberation and Interrogative Attention
subchannels.scene_or_process: An affair is turned over in thought, opened to consultation, and brought before an addressee through an attention-commanding question.
subchannels.active_motifs: inward judgment `ر ء ي:B002/m01`; consultation `ء م ر:B007/m01`; matter under consideration `ء م ر:B001/m01`; interrogative attention `ر ء ي:B013/m01`; recognition `ع ل م:B001/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: The repeated interrogative surface form becomes a deliberative frame. A matter is mentally weighed, exposed to counsel, and then presented so that the hearer must recognize its moral or practical consequence.

subchannels.name: Flags, Marks, and Guiding Landmarks
subchannels.scene_or_process: A visible object is raised or differentiated so that it marks a place, time, party, or route.
subchannels.active_motifs: appointed sign `ء م ر:B005/m01`; raised flag `ر ء ي:B011/m01`; distinguishing landmark `ع ل م:B002/m01`; elevation `س م و:B001/m01`; gentle directional indication `ه د ي:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Elevation makes a marker conspicuous, the flag embodies that visibility, and the landmark turns visibility into guidance. Appointment adds a temporal function, so the same sign can orient movement or announce a due moment.

subchannels.name: Showing, Detecting, and Verifying
subchannels.scene_or_process: A concealed condition is deliberately shown, sensed by an observer, and held long enough for verification.
subchannels.active_motifs: deliberate showing `ر ء ي:B012/m01`; sensory detection `ء ن س:B002/m01`; detention for verification `ق ر ء:B010/m01`; manifest appearance `ن د و:B008/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Showing is the initiating act, detection is the observer's uptake, and temporary detention protects the judgment from haste. The image of something becoming so manifest that it seems to call out completes the disclosure process.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Something hidden or unknown becomes apprehensible through instruction, perception, inquiry, indication, or controlled disclosure.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 96:1-5 centers reading, naming, teaching, the pen, and human learning, while 96:9, 96:11, 96:13, and 96:14 repeatedly stage seeing, questioning, and knowing.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The channel extends from pedagogy and eyesight to banners, landmarks, appointments, and verification procedures.

parent_channels.name: Address and Response

subchannels.name: Call, Raised Voice, Echo, and Song
subchannels.scene_or_process: A caller projects a voice across distance, the sound carries or returns, and repeated tone can become song or public repute.
subchannels.active_motifs: vocal summons `د ع و:B001/m01`; raised call `ن د و:B002/m01`; returned echo `ر ج ع:B007/m01`; singing voice `غ ن ي:B003/m01`; far-reaching good repute `س م و:B008/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Calling supplies an emitter and addressee, raised voice supplies range, and echo supplies acoustic return. Song and reputation extend the same propagation pattern from immediate sound to a voice that continues socially.

subchannels.name: Greeting and Courteous Reply
subchannels.scene_or_process: A formulaic greeting reaches another party and is met by a returned, gracious response.
subchannels.active_motifs: conveyed greeting `ق ر ء:B006/m01`; verbal reply `ر ج ع:B005/m01`; gracious acceptance `ك ر م:B009/m01`; attention to the addressee `ر ء ي:B013/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The greeting is not isolated wording but the first half of a social transaction. Return speech completes it, while graciousness specifies the expected quality of the answer.

subchannels.name: Riddle and Answer
subchannels.scene_or_process: An opaque verbal problem is posed, held before an interlocutor, and resolved by a returned answer.
subchannels.active_motifs: enigmatic utterance `د ع و:B007/m01`; answer returned in speech `ر ج ع:B005/m02`; satisfying response `ك ر م:B009/m02`; interrogative attention `ر ء ي:B013/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: The opaque utterance creates an information gap, interrogative attention assigns it to a respondent, and the returned answer closes the exchange. The courteous-response motif gives the successful solution a social as well as intellectual outcome.

subchannels.name: Injunction and Exhortation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A speaker draws attention, presses an obligation, and urges the hearer toward an action.
subchannels.active_motifs: imperative obligation `ك ذ ب:B003/m01`; verbal urging `د ع و:B001/m02`; command and requirement `ء م ر:B002/m01`; interrogative alert `ر ء ي:B013/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Attention is first captured, then obligation is placed upon the addressee, and the call supplies forward pressure. This scene explains how interrogative address and direct command can operate as one exhortative mechanism.

subchannels.name: Poetic Pattern and Exchange
subchannels.scene_or_process: A verbal model supplies the pattern for composition, and completed verse is passed between speakers.
subchannels.active_motifs: poetic model `ق ر ء:B005/m01`; intended verbal method `ق ر ء:B011/m01`; exchanged verse `ه د ي:B011/m01`; voiced delivery `ن د و:B002/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: A model determines the path of composition, while reciprocal gifting of verse turns form into a social exchange. Raised delivery gives the patterned text an audible public life.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Speech moves between parties by attracting attention, projecting a voice, requesting uptake, and eliciting an answer.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; commands to read at 96:1 and 96:3, repeated interrogative address at 96:9, 96:11, and 96:13, and reciprocal calling at 96:17-18 provide the surface frame.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The same exchange structure reaches greeting formulas, echoes, song, riddles, exhortation, and exchanged verse.

parent_channels.name: Truth, Claim, and Deceptive Presentation

subchannels.name: Fabricating a False Account
subchannels.scene_or_process: Speech is invented, presented as an account of reality, and contradicted by the truth it displaces.
subchannels.active_motifs: fabricated speech `خ ل ق:B007/m01`; falsehood `ك ذ ب:B001/m01`; attribution of lying `ك ذ ب:B002/m01`; known reality `ع ل م:B001/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: Fabrication supplies the production act, falsehood names the defective product, and imputation assigns responsibility for it. Knowledge provides the counter-state against which the invented account fails.

subchannels.name: Claim, Lineage, and Attached Litigation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A party asserts a right or affiliation, the assertion adheres to an opponent as a dispute, and speech is returned in contest.
subchannels.active_motifs: asserted right `د ع و:B002/m01`; attached lawsuit `ع ل ق:B005/m01`; fabricated pleading `خ ل ق:B007/m02`; contested reply `ر ج ع:B005/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: The claim initiates a social and legal attachment rather than a neutral statement. Once it adheres to another party, fabrication and reply become opposing operations within one dispute.

subchannels.name: Imputation and Refutation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person or statement is branded false, displayed for examination, and measured against recognized knowledge.
subchannels.active_motifs: imputation of falsehood `ك ذ ب:B002/m01`; deliberate display `ر ء ي:B012/m01`; recognition `ع ل م:B001/m02`; reply to accusation `ر ج ع:B005/m04`
subchannels.synthesis: Imputation creates a disputed status, display makes the disputed object examinable, and recognition supplies the basis for refutation. Returned speech completes the adversarial exchange.

subchannels.name: The Deceiving and Self-Protective Self
subchannels.scene_or_process: The inner self generates a misleading account, facilitates its own course, and encloses itself against correction.
subchannels.active_motifs: deceitful self `ك ذ ب:B008/m01`; self-protective enclosure `و ق ي:B002/m01`; inward facilitation `ط و ع:B006/m01`; self-assertion `د ع و:B002/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: Deception is internalized as a self-maintaining process. The self makes its chosen action easy, asserts its account, and converts protection from harm into insulation from contradiction.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A representation is asserted, tested against what is known, and either sustained as truth or exposed as fabrication.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; denial and turning away at 96:13, divine seeing at 96:14, and the lying, erring forelock at 96:16 make truth status an explicit surface concern.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Falsehood expands into authorship, attached legal claims, imputation, and a self that protects its own deception.

parent_channels.name: Origination, Shaping, and Material Form

subchannels.name: Origination and Coming-to-Be
subchannels.scene_or_process: Something is brought into occurrence, then nurtured toward a completed state.
subchannels.active_motifs: origination `خ ل ق:B002/m01`; temporal occurrence `ك و ن:B001/m01`; nurture and completion `ر ب ب:B002/m01`; completed form `خ ل ق:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Creation initiates existence, occurrence places it in an actual time, and nurture carries it toward completion. The process therefore joins event, development, and finished form.

subchannels.name: Measuring, Paring, and Cutting to Fit
subchannels.scene_or_process: A desired measure is established and hard material is pared or clipped until it conforms.
subchannels.active_motifs: estimation and measure `خ ل ق:B001/m01`; paring to level `ق ل م:B001/m01`; cutting shears `ق ل م:B006/m01`; bounded amount `ن ه ي:B010/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Measurement supplies the intended form, paring removes excess, and shears perform the controlled separation. The terminal amount defines when shaping is complete.

subchannels.name: Proportion, Appearance, and Reflection
subchannels.scene_or_process: A completed, proportioned body becomes available as an appearance and is duplicated in a reflecting surface.
subchannels.active_motifs: proportioned form `خ ل ق:B003/m02`; visible appearance `ر ء ي:B006/m01`; reflected likeness `ر ء ي:B006/m02`; recognition of form `ع ل م:B001/m04`
subchannels.synthesis: Proportion gives the object a stable outline, appearance presents that outline, and reflection repeats it. Recognition closes the scene by identifying the likeness as belonging to the formed object.

subchannels.name: Smooth Slabs, Raised Places, and Solid Blockage
subchannels.scene_or_process: Stone or ground is apprehended through surface qualities: level smoothness, elevation, or impenetrable closure.
subchannels.active_motifs: smooth level surface `خ ل ق:B008/m01`; imperforate rock `خ ل ق:B012/m01`; smooth slab `ط غ ي:B005/m01`; raised rocky place `ط غ و:B006/m01`; conspicuous elevation `س م و:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `خ ل ق` 96:1-2; `ط غ ي` 96:6 (يَطْغَى); `ط غ و` has no separate surface token; `س م و` 96:1
subchannels.synthesis: Smoothness and elevation make a slab visually distinct, while imperforation changes the same material into a barrier. The scene is a topology of stone in which surface and passage determine function.

subchannels.name: Clefts, Tips, and Deliberate Edges
subchannels.scene_or_process: A continuous surface is opened by a cleft or terminated in a pared point.
subchannels.active_motifs: visible cleft `ع ل م:B004/m01`; pared tip `ق ل م:B005/m01`; controlled trimming `ق ل م:B001/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: The cleft marks where continuity fails, while paring deliberately creates a terminal edge. Together they form a compact morphology of opening, boundary, and point.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Form emerges through creation, measurement, cutting, smoothing, differentiation, and completion.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; creation at 96:1-2 and teaching by the pen at 96:4 provide both origination and tool-mediated shaping.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The same formative logic reaches mirrors, pared edges, cleft surfaces, raised slabs, and solid barriers.

parent_channels.name: The Reproductive Sequence

subchannels.name: Mating and Conception
subchannels.scene_or_process: An animal enters estrus, the male mounts, and a conception becomes fixed in the womb.
subchannels.active_motifs: estrus `ق ر ء:B009/m01`; mounting male `س م و:B003/m01`; fixed conception `ع ل ق:B009/m01`; checking pregnancy `ر ج ع:B013/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Estrus supplies reproductive readiness, mounting supplies contact, and the fastening sense of conception supplies the outcome. Rechecking the animal turns an initially hidden event into a monitored state.

subchannels.name: Gestation, Bodily Signs, and Imminent Birth
subchannels.scene_or_process: The womb gathers its contents, pregnancy becomes visible, and detention in gestation ends as birth approaches.
subchannels.active_motifs: gathered womb contents `ق ر ء:B003/m01`; visible pregnancy `ر ء ي:B010/m01`; gestational holding `ق ر ء:B004/m01`; imminent birth `ق ر ب:B012/m01`; menstrual sign `ر ء ي:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Gathering and holding describe the interior process, menstrual and visible-pregnancy signs disclose its condition, and nearness changes from spatial relation into the approach of delivery.

subchannels.name: Milk, Fosterage, and Maternal Substitution
subchannels.scene_or_process: A caregiver or surrogate tends the young while milk starts, is withheld, or fails.
subchannels.active_motifs: foster caregiver `ر ب ب:B005/m01`; first call of milk `د ع و:B003/m01`; surrogate dam withholding milk `ع ل ق:B010/m01`; milk ceasing `ك ذ ب:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Fosterage provides the social role, while the milk branches describe the resource on which care depends. Initiation, withholding, and cessation make nourishment a changing process rather than a static possession.

subchannels.name: Young Animals, Nurture, and Weaning
subchannels.scene_or_process: A newly born lamb or ewe is tended, matured, and eventually separated from the older stock.
subchannels.active_motifs: young lamb `ء م ر:B009/m01`; newly delivered ewe `ر ب ب:B009/m01`; nurture to completion `ر ب ب:B002/m01`; separation of young stock `و ل ي:B015/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Newness identifies the dependent animal, nurture carries it through early development, and sequential separation marks weaning. The process converts biological birth into managed herd continuity.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Animal and human life proceeds through mating, conception, gestation, visible signs, birth, milk, fostering, and separation of the young.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 96:2 names human creation from `عَلَق`, and the lexical branches unfold that compact origin into a full reproductive cycle.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The sequence includes estrus, pregnancy verification, milk interruption, foster care, and weaning.

parent_channels.name: Marriage, Kinship, and Household Bond

subchannels.name: Bridal Transfer and Marriage
subchannels.scene_or_process: A woman recognized for beauty or independence is transferred as a bride and enters marriage through a gift-bearing social act.
subchannels.active_motifs: marriageable woman `غ ن ي:B005/m01`; marriage `غ ن ي:B006/m01`; bride led to her spouse `ه د ي:B006/m01`; reciprocal bridal gift `ك ر م:B008/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Marriage changes status, bridal guidance supplies the public transfer, and the recompense-seeking gift places the union inside a reciprocal social economy.

subchannels.name: Suspension, Separation, and Marital Return
subchannels.scene_or_process: A spouse is left between marriage and singleness, may become fully separated, or may be restored to the household.
subchannels.active_motifs: suspended wife `ع ل ق:B008/m01`; marital return `ر ج ع:B004/m01`; spouseless separation `ق ل م:B009/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Suspension names the unstable middle state, separation resolves it toward singleness, and return resolves it toward renewed household membership.

subchannels.name: Descent, Clientage, and Covenant
subchannels.scene_or_process: Kinship or claimed descent is extended by oath, covenant, neighborhood, manumission, and alliance.
subchannels.active_motifs: blood kinship `ق ر ب:B003/m01`; clientage and manumission `و ل ي:B005/m01`; covenant `ر ب ب:B011/m01`; binding oath `ء ل ي:B007/m01`; lineage assertion `د ع و:B002/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Descent supplies inherited proximity, while oath and covenant create chosen proximity. Clientage and manumission show how the resulting bond can reorganize legal belonging beyond blood.

subchannels.name: Dependents, Care, and Surety
subchannels.scene_or_process: A household head holds wealth and dependents, assumes care, and guarantees another person's standing.
subchannels.active_motifs: wealth and dependents `ق ر ء:B013/m01`; ward or stepchild `ر ب ب:B005/m02`; guardianship `و ل ي:B003/m02`; surety `ك و ن:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Dependents create an obligation, guardianship supplies ongoing administration, and surety makes the caregiver answerable for another. The ward motif gives the household relation a concrete recipient.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Social continuity is created and altered through marriage, return or separation, descent, covenant, clientage, and care for dependents.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; human identity at 96:2, claimed self-sufficiency at 96:7, return at 96:8, and turning away at 96:13 activate lexical branches concerned with dependence and relational status.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The channel moves from bridal transfer to suspended marriage, foster relations, oath-bound alliance, manumission, and household surety.

parent_channels.name: Devotion and Consecrated Approach

subchannels.name: Lordship, Invocation, and Worship
subchannels.scene_or_process: The divine is named and invoked as sovereign, and the human participant answers as servant and worshipper.
subchannels.active_motifs: divine invocation `ء ل ه:B002/m01`; sovereignty `ر ب ب:B001/m01`; worshipped deity `ء ل ه:B001/m01`; submissive worship `ع ب د:B003/m01`; blessing and praise `ص ل و:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Naming identifies the sovereign, invocation addresses that sovereignty, and servanthood defines the human role. Praise and blessing turn recognition into an enacted relation.

subchannels.name: Prayer, Prostration, and Sacred Place
subchannels.scene_or_process: A worshipper enters a designated place, lowers the body, and performs prayer through prostration.
subchannels.active_motifs: prescribed prayer `ص ل و:B003/m01`; bodily lowering `س ج د:B001/m01`; place of prostration `س ج د:B002/m01`; house of worship `ص ل و:B007/m01`; prostrating limbs and mark `س ج د:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Place, posture, limbs, and act form one ritual scene. The bodily mark extends a momentary prostration into a visible trace carried after worship.

subchannels.name: Offering and Sanctuary Approach
subchannels.scene_or_process: A gift or animal is brought near, directed toward sanctuary, and converted into an offering.
subchannels.active_motifs: approach-offering `ق ر ب:B005/m01`; sanctuary animal `ه د ي:B005/m01`; bestowed gift `ء ل ي:B012/m01`; devotional companionship `ء ن س:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Nearness becomes ritual transfer: a gift is directed toward a sacred destination, and the offered animal embodies that movement. Companionship supplies the relational aim of restored nearness.

subchannels.name: Fragrance, Aloeswood, and Ritual Grinding
subchannels.scene_or_process: Aromatic material is ground on stone, compounded, and applied in a setting of honor or worship.
subchannels.active_motifs: fragrant anointment `خ ل ق:B010/m01`; perfume mortar `ع ب د:B012/m01`; grinding slab `ص ل و:B008/m01`; aloeswood `ء ل ي:B014/m01`; worship place `ص ل و:B007/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Aloeswood supplies aromatic material, mortar and slab supply the preparation mechanism, and anointment supplies the outcome. Its repeated attachment to worship places turns fragrance into consecrated atmosphere.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A worshipper recognizes sovereignty, adopts a posture of service, and approaches through prayer, prostration, offering, and consecrated preparation.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; lordship and the divine name at 96:1, 96:3, 96:8, and 96:14, prayer at 96:10, and prostration with approach at 96:19 establish the channel.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Worship opens into sacred places, sanctuary livestock, fragrant anointment, aloeswood, and perfume grinding.

parent_channels.name: Authority, Obedience, and Restraint

subchannels.name: Command and Moral Inhibition
subchannels.scene_or_process: An authority imposes a requirement, while reason and protective restraint inhibit a prohibited act.
subchannels.active_motifs: binding command `ء م ر:B002/m01`; prohibition `ن ه ي:B001/m01`; morally restraining reason `ن ه ي:B003/m01`; protective restraint `و ق ي:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Command supplies positive direction, prohibition blocks an opposing action, and reason internalizes the restraint. Protection frames inhibition as preservation rather than mere stoppage.

subchannels.name: Obedience, Submission, and Prostration
subchannels.scene_or_process: A participant consents, yields status, lowers the body, and carries out an act under authority.
subchannels.active_motifs: obedience `ط و ع:B001/m01`; concurrence `ط و ع:B002/m01`; submissive worship `ع ب د:B003/m01`; abasement `ك و ن:B004/m01`; bodily lowering `س ج د:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Concurrence marks assent, obedience turns assent into action, and lowering makes the changed rank visible. Worship gives submission a chosen sacred form.

subchannels.name: Refusal, Turning Away, and Transgression
subchannels.scene_or_process: A subject crosses a limit, refuses direction, and turns away from an imposed or recognized claim.
subchannels.active_motifs: moral excess `ط غ ي:B001/m01`; refusal and retreat `و ل ي:B007/m01`; crossing the correct boundary `خ ط ء:B001/m01`; rejected prohibition `ن ه ي:B001/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Transgression is a boundary crossing, refusal is a directional reversal, and turning away gives that reversal a bodily image. Prohibition remains the limit against which the refusal is legible.

subchannels.name: Forelock Seizure and Repulsive Force
subchannels.scene_or_process: An offending person is seized at the forelock, physically driven back, and struck or restrained.
subchannels.active_motifs: forelock seizure `س ف ع:B001/m01`; grasped forelock `ن ص ي:B001/m01`; repulsion `ز ب ن:B001/m01`; striking `س ف ع:B004/m01`; enforced stoppage `ن ه ي:B001/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: The forelock supplies the point of control, repulsion supplies directed force, and striking supplies enforcement. The lexical scene concretizes moral restraint as capture and bodily displacement.

subchannels.name: Wrongdoing, Return, and Desistance
subchannels.scene_or_process: A wrong is recognized, the actor turns back from it, and pursuit of the former course ceases.
subchannels.active_motifs: sinful error `خ ط ء:B002/m01`; repentance and reversal `ر ج ع:B003/m01`; desistance `ن ه ي:B007/m01`; turning away from a course `و ل ي:B007/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Error establishes the defective course, return reverses its direction, and desistance prevents renewed pursuit. The same turning image can therefore express culpable refusal or corrective repentance according to its object.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Conduct is regulated by command, moral inhibition, willing submission, refusal, and coercive enforcement.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; transgression at 96:6, prohibition at 96:9 and 96:15, command to piety at 96:12, denial and turning away at 96:13, forelock seizure at 96:15-16, and non-obedience at 96:19 form the surface sequence.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Regulation extends from conscience and repentance to repulsion, striking, enslavement, and submission at an endpoint.

parent_channels.name: Council, Assembly, and Rank

subchannels.name: Forum and Deliberative Council
subchannels.scene_or_process: People meet face to face in a recognized forum and deliberate over an affair.
subchannels.active_motifs: public council `ن د و:B001/m01`; gathering place `ن د ي:B003/m01`; consultation `ء م ر:B007/m01`; face-to-face encounter `ر ء ي:B004/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ن د و` 96:17; `ن د ي` has no separate surface token; `ء م ر` 96:12; `ر ء ي` 96:7, 96:9, 96:11, 96:13-14
subchannels.synthesis: The forum supplies place and participants, facing supplies reciprocal visibility, and consultation supplies the joint operation. The result is a social decision scene rather than an undifferentiated crowd.

subchannels.name: Summons and Assembly
subchannels.scene_or_process: A raised call draws separate people into a gathered body.
subchannels.active_motifs: summons `د ع و:B001/m01`; raised call `ن د و:B002/m01`; multitude `ر ب ب:B004/m01`; collection `ق ر ء:B001/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Voice initiates movement toward a center, collection supplies the converging action, and multitude names the resulting body. The two surface summons sharpen this into competing mobilizations.

subchannels.name: Dispersal and the Empty Dwelling
subchannels.scene_or_process: A former group scatters until the dwelling has neither caller nor inhabitant.
subchannels.active_motifs: dispersal in different directions `ع ب د:B010/m01`; scattered remnants `ن د ي:B012/m01`; empty house `د ع و:B008/m01`; nobody present `ز ب ن:B007/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ع ب د` 96:10; `ن د ي` has no separate surface token; `د ع و` 96:17-18; `ز ب ن` 96:18
subchannels.synthesis: Dispersal is the process, scattered remnants are its spatial trace, and the silent house is its social outcome. Absence is defined concretely by the disappearance of both speaker and audience.

subchannels.name: Elite, Leader, and Court Intimate
subchannels.scene_or_process: A selected person advances at the front, gains privileged proximity, and serves as an intimate of power.
subchannels.active_motifs: chosen elite `ن ص ي:B003/m01`; leading front `ه د ي:B003/m01`; court favorite `ق ر ب:B004/m01`; intimate confidant `ء ن س:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Selection differentiates the elite, precedence gives that person a leading position, and nearness to authority becomes court privilege. Intimacy describes the social access produced by rank.

subchannels.name: Governance and Delegated Care
subchannels.scene_or_process: A ruler or officeholder assumes an affair and becomes responsible for its administration.
subchannels.active_motifs: political authority `ء م ر:B003/m01`; holding office `و ل ي:B003/m01`; affair under rule `ء م ر:B001/m02`; lordly sovereignty `ر ب ب:B001/m02`; delegated surety `ك و ن:B003/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: The affair supplies an object of administration, office assigns a responsible agent, and sovereignty supplies the hierarchy above that agent. Surety extends governance into answerability for those placed under care.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: People become a public body by gathering, calling, deliberating, assigning rank, or dispersing into absence.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 96:17 names a caller and his club or council, while 96:18 answers with a counter-summons.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The social field includes multitudes, empty dwellings, intimate retainers, court privilege, leadership, and delegated office.

parent_channels.name: Value, Gift, and Social Esteem

subchannels.name: Precious Attachment and Veneration
subchannels.scene_or_process: A valued object or person is held close, treated as precious, and publicly honored.
subchannels.active_motifs: precious attachment `ع ل ق:B007/m01`; beloved rarity `ك ر م:B010/m01`; veneration `ع ب د:B006/m01`; honorable worth `ك ر م:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Attachment supplies possession and emotional closeness, preciousness supplies scarcity, and veneration converts private value into public treatment.

subchannels.name: Gift, Assignment, and Recompense
subchannels.scene_or_process: A gift is sent or assigned to another with an expectation of affection, return, or recompense.
subchannels.active_motifs: bestowal `ء ل ي:B012/m01`; affectionate gift `ه د ي:B004/m01`; recompense-seeking gift `ك ر م:B008/m01`; assigned benefit or harm `و ل ي:B013/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Bestowal initiates transfer, the dispatched gift gives it a recipient and route, and expected recompense makes the act reciprocal. Assignment shows that transfer can carry either favor or burden.

subchannels.name: Generosity, Favor, and Prosperity
subchannels.scene_or_process: Abundant giving produces favor, growth, and a condition in which need is relieved.
subchannels.active_motifs: openhanded generosity `ن د و:B004/m01`; growth and blessing `ء م ر:B004/m01`; divine favors `ء ل ي:B006/m01`; favor relieving a need `ر ب ب:B016/m03`; noble generosity `ك ر م:B001/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Giving is pictured as an abundance that nourishes growth. Favor is the received outcome, while relief of need shows prosperity at the level of the beneficiary.

subchannels.name: Rivalry, Ostentation, and Reputation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Competitors display themselves, boast of excellence, and seek a reputation that travels beyond the encounter.
subchannels.active_motifs: rivalry `س م و:B007/m01`; boastful contest in generosity `ك ر م:B006/m01`; ostentatious display `ر ء ي:B005/m01`; spreading repute `س م و:B008/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Rivalry supplies opposing agents, ostentation supplies display, boasting supplies the claim to superiority, and reputation is the social residue that persists after the contest.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Persons and goods acquire social value through honor, attachment, generosity, reciprocal giving, praise, and rivalry.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; the divine superlative `ٱلْأَكْرَمُ` at 96:3 and the claim of self-sufficiency at 96:7 place generosity, worth, and independence on the surface.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Esteem attaches to treasured objects, gracious answers, gifts seeking recompense, public boasting, and reputational sound.

parent_channels.name: Orientation, Nearness, and Completion

subchannels.name: Facing and Direction
subchannels.scene_or_process: A body presents its inward side, turns its face, and adopts a direction or intended course.
subchannels.active_motifs: inward-facing side `ء ن س:B004/m01`; turning the face `و ل ي:B006/m01`; direction `ه د ي:B002/m01`; attentive sight `ر ء ي:B001/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Orientation begins in anatomy, becomes a deliberate turn, and culminates in a chosen direction. Sight aligns attention with the body's facing.

subchannels.name: Nearness, Adjacency, and Contact
subchannels.scene_or_process: Separate entities close distance, become adjacent without an interval, and may enter direct contact.
subchannels.active_motifs: nearness `ق ر ب:B001/m01`; interval-free adjacency `و ل ي:B001/m01`; contact and engagement `ق ر ب:B007/m01`; kinship nearness `ق ر ب:B003/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Nearness is the approach, adjacency is the resulting position, and contact is the intensified relation. Kin proximity shows how the same spatial structure can organize social belonging.

subchannels.name: Return, Abiding, and Residence
subchannels.scene_or_process: A moving subject reverses course, reaches a place, and remains there.
subchannels.active_motifs: return `ر ج ع:B001/m01`; abiding `ر ب ب:B007/m01`; dwelling in a place `غ ن ي:B004/m01`; place and station `ك و ن:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Return supplies directional reversal, place supplies a destination, and abiding changes arrival into residence. The surface `ٱلرُّجْعَى` thus opens both eschatological and locative readings.

subchannels.name: Endpoint and Attainment
subchannels.scene_or_process: Movement proceeds toward a terminal boundary that can be reached, possessed, or completed.
subchannels.active_motifs: endpoint `ء ل ي:B001/m01`; terminal limit `ن ه ي:B002/m01`; goal attainment `و ل ي:B012/m01`; imminent completion `ق ر ب:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Endpoint defines the boundary, imminence describes the approach, and attainment names successful arrival. The same structure supports spatial, temporal, and purposive completion.

subchannels.name: Succession, Gait, and Race Order
subchannels.scene_or_process: Bodies move in sequence, one follows another, and gait determines position in a race or procession.
subchannels.active_motifs: succession `و ل ي:B002/m01`; second horse `ص ل و:B006/m01`; trotting approach `ق ر ب:B014/m01`; animal gait `ر ج ع:B008/m01`; swaying walk `ه د ي:B008/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Succession supplies order, gait supplies the repeated motion that maintains it, and the second horse makes relative position explicit. Swaying and trotting are contrasting realizations of patterned advance.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Relations are organized by direction, distance, contact, return, succession, and arrival at a limit.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; return to the Lord at 96:8, turning away at 96:13, and the imperative to approach at 96:19 make directed relation central to the surface.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Spatial nearness expands into bodily facing, residence, temporal imminence, race order, and goal attainment.

parent_channels.name: Readiness, Need, and Sufficiency

subchannels.name: Aptitude, Entitlement, and Undertaking
subchannels.scene_or_process: A suitable agent is judged fit, gains priority, and begins the assigned action.
subchannels.active_motifs: fitness `خ ل ق:B005/m01`; beginning an undertaking `ع ل ق:B016/m01`; entitlement `و ل ي:B008/m01`; intended course `ه د ي:B002/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Fitness answers who can act, entitlement answers who should act, intention gives the action direction, and commencement changes potential into execution.

subchannels.name: Capacity and Exertion
subchannels.scene_or_process: Ability is present or deliberately acquired, then expended as effort.
subchannels.active_motifs: capacity `ء ل ي:B011/m01`; practical ability `ط و ع:B003/m01`; taking on ability `ط و ع:B004/m01`; exertion `ء ل ي:B010/m01`; bodily strength `ع ب د:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Capacity is the available resource, taking on ability is its acquisition, strength is its bodily substrate, and exertion is its expenditure toward a task.

subchannels.name: Subsistence and Provision
subchannels.scene_or_process: Food need motivates effort, while a small provision or ready pasture sustains dependents and animals.
subchannels.active_motifs: food need `ز ب ن:B006/m01`; minimal subsistence `ع ل ق:B006/m01`; wealth and dependents `ق ر ء:B013/m01`; ready pasture `ط و ع:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Need is the deficit, provision is the portable remedy, and pasture is the environmental remedy. Dependents make adequacy a household responsibility rather than an individual state.

subchannels.name: Adequacy and Independence
subchannels.scene_or_process: Provision reaches a sufficient level, further seeking stops, and the possessor experiences independence.
subchannels.active_motifs: adequacy `غ ن ي:B002/m01`; sufficient endpoint `ن ه ي:B005/m01`; independence `غ ن ي:B001/m01`; cessation of seeking `ن ه ي:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Adequacy names the threshold, cessation marks its behavioral effect, and independence names the resulting social condition. The surface warns that perceived independence can also misrecognize continuing dependence.

subchannels.name: Care, Guarantee, and Protective Support
subchannels.scene_or_process: A responsible party guarantees another, supplies what is lacking, and protects against breakdown.
subchannels.active_motifs: surety `ك و ن:B003/m01`; adequate support `غ ن ي:B002/m02`; nurture `ر ب ب:B002/m02`; protection from harm `و ق ي:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Surety assigns responsibility, nurture supplies continued care, adequacy defines the required outcome, and protection preserves the supported person from loss.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Action depends on fitness, acquired capacity, effort, provision, and the point at which need is adequately met.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; perceived self-sufficiency at 96:7, command to protective piety at 96:12, and obedience at 96:19 place capacity and dependence in explicit tension.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The channel includes vocation, beginning a task, food need, subsistence fodder, surety, and voluntary exertion.

parent_channels.name: Water, Rain, and Fertile Ground

subchannels.name: Cloud, Rain, and Seasonal Succession
subchannels.scene_or_process: Cloud cover gathers overhead, rain returns to the ground, and one seasonal shower follows another.
subchannels.active_motifs: cloud bank `ر ب ب:B008/m01`; overhanging sky `س م و:B004/m01`; returning rain `ر ج ع:B006/m01`; following seasonal rain `و ل ي:B010/m01`; dew and rainfall `ن د و:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The cloud is the source, descent is the event, return expresses recurrence, and following rain creates seasonal order. Dew supplies the gentler end of the same moisture continuum.

subchannels.name: Flood, Gathering Water, and Terminal Pool
subchannels.scene_or_process: Water rises beyond bounds, flows with force, and settles where the channel terminates.
subchannels.active_motifs: overpowering flood `ط غ ي:B002/m01`; water exceeding its limit `ط غ و:B002/m01`; terminal pool `ن ه ي:B004/m01`; gathered great water `ع ل م:B005/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ط غ ي` 96:6; `ط غ و` has no separate surface token; `ن ه ي` 96:9, 96:15; `ع ل م` 96:4-5, 96:14
subchannels.synthesis: Excess and force describe the moving flood, while the terminal pool supplies its endpoint. The gathered-water motif scales the result from a local basin to a broad body of water.

subchannels.name: Well, Pulley, and Waterskin
subchannels.scene_or_process: Water is retained in an excavation, lifted by suspended gear, and transferred into a portable skin.
subchannels.active_motifs: water-holding well `خ ل ق:B011/m01`; suspended pulley `ع ل ق:B002/m01`; waterskin `ق ر ب:B009/m01`; abundant water `ر ب ب:B013/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The well supplies storage, the pulley supplies mechanical lift, and the waterskin supplies transport. Abundance describes the resource before it is divided into usable loads.

subchannels.name: Rain-Fed Pasture and Plant Growth
subchannels.scene_or_process: Fertile rain prepares soil, plants emerge, and pasture becomes available to grazing animals.
subchannels.active_motifs: fertile rain and soil `ك ر م:B002/m01`; general plant growth `ر ب ب:B012/m01`; fodder grass `ن ص ي:B004/m01`; camel pasture `ص ل و:B009/m01`; herb outside the main stock `ق ل م:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Rain changes the condition of the soil, plant motifs specify the resulting vegetation, and pasture gives that growth an ecological consumer. The stray herb preserves diversity within the field.

subchannels.name: Watering Circuit and Ripening
subchannels.scene_or_process: Herds travel between water and pasture while fruit or herbage advances from readiness to over-ripeness.
subchannels.active_motifs: night approach to water `ق ر ب:B008/m01`; herd watering circuit `ن د و:B006/m01`; ready pasture and fruit `ط و ع:B007/m01`; overripe drying fruit `و ل ي:B016/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Watering and grazing form a repeated route, while ripening supplies the parallel temporal cycle of the field. Readiness is the usable interval before drying and decline.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Water descends, surges, gathers, is drawn or carried, and turns ground into pasture and ripened growth.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; the transgression root at 96:6 carries a flood sense, generosity at 96:3 carries fertile rain, and approach at 96:19 carries a watering-place sense.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The hydrological scene includes cloud cover, seasonal rain, terminal pools, wells, pulleys, waterskins, herd watering, and overripe fruit.

parent_channels.name: Bodily Signs, Illness, and Vitality

subchannels.name: Lung Ailment and Epidemic Environment
subchannels.scene_or_process: A diseased environment affects breathing, produces torpor, and calls for bodily protection.
subchannels.active_motifs: lung and its ailment `ر ء ي:B009/m01`; epidemic land `ق ر ء:B008/m01`; protective enclosure `و ق ي:B002/m02`; sluggish weakness `ه د ي:B009/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The epidemic supplies the setting, the lung supplies the affected organ, torpor supplies the state, and protection supplies the response.

subchannels.name: Blood Sign and Therapeutic Leech
subchannels.scene_or_process: Thick blood or cyclical discharge is observed, and a leech or tissue intervention is used to draw blood.
subchannels.active_motifs: clot or thick blood `ع ل ق:B003/m01`; medicinal leech `ع ل ق:B003/m02`; menstrual sign `ر ء ي:B007/m01`; leech bloodletting `ع ل ق:B012/m02`; cleft upper lip `ع ل م:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Blood appears first as substance and diagnostic sign, then the leech changes role from bloodlike creature to therapeutic instrument. The cleft or treated tissue provides the bodily site of intervention.

subchannels.name: Belly, Flank, Back, and Hip Pain
subchannels.scene_or_process: Pain is localized by adjacent anatomical regions and the joints that bear movement.
subchannels.active_motifs: abdominal pang `ن ص ي:B006/m01`; flank `ق ر ب:B015/m01`; back and side `ص ل و:B005/m01`; hip socket `ك ر م:B007/m01`; hoof-protective response to pain `و ق ي:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The pang supplies sensation, flank and back supply location, and the hip socket supplies a load-bearing joint. Hoof protection extends the same pain-to-compensation process into animal biomechanics.

subchannels.name: Strength, Fullness, and Corpulence
subchannels.scene_or_process: Sustained nourishment becomes bodily firmness and reaches a terminal fullness.
subchannels.active_motifs: bodily strength `ع ب د:B007/m01`; extreme fatness `ن ه ي:B006/m01`; animal of noble lineage `ن د و:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Strength names functional capacity, fatness names accumulated bodily reserve, and noble lineage provides the husbandry setting in which fullness is read as condition and value.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Internal condition becomes legible through breath, blood, pain, bodily marks, weakness, or fullness.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; `عَلَق` at 96:2, seeing at 96:7-14, and the forelock at 96:15-16 activate concrete physiological and diagnostic branches.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The channel includes lung disease, epidemic terrain, menstruation, leech treatment, cleft tissue, flank pain, hip sockets, and corpulence.

parent_channels.name: Textile, Marking, and Adornment

subchannels.name: Dyed, Iridescent, and Deceptive Cloth
subchannels.scene_or_process: Cloth is dyed or woven with changing color, fitted to the body, and made capable of overstating its quality.
subchannels.active_motifs: dyed garment `س ف ع:B007/m01`; deceptive cloth `ك ذ ب:B009/m01`; iridescent fabric `ق ل م:B010/m01`; small bodice `ع ل ق:B015/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Dye and iridescence create visual attraction, the bodice gives the fabric bodily placement, and deceptive appearance explains how surface can claim a value the material does not possess.

subchannels.name: Wear, Fraying, and Recycled Material
subchannels.scene_or_process: Repeated use removes a garment's nap, turns it into worn material, and redirects it into another use.
subchannels.active_motifs: worn cloth `خ ل ق:B009/m01`; returned or recycled matter `ر ج ع:B015/m01`; repair and completion `ر ب ب:B002/m03`; visible wear mark `ع ل م:B002/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Fraying is the process, worn material is the changed object, and return becomes material reuse. Repair counters that decline, while visible marks retain the history of wear.

subchannels.name: Tattoo, Dark Trace, and Repeated Line
subchannels.scene_or_process: A line is repeatedly inscribed into a surface and darkened until it becomes a durable identifying trace.
subchannels.active_motifs: repeated tattoo line `ر ج ع:B009/m01`; black-red coloration `س ف ع:B002/m02`; pathlike trace `ن د ي:B013/m01`; distinguishing mark `ع ل م:B002/m03`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ر ج ع` 96:8; `س ف ع` 96:15; `ن د ي` has no separate surface token; `ع ل م` 96:4-5, 96:14
subchannels.synthesis: Repetition lays down the line, coloration makes it visible, and the resulting trace acquires identifying force. The scene links inscription and bodily marking without collapsing either into generic writing.

subchannels.name: Hair, Forelock, and Grooming
subchannels.scene_or_process: Hair is lengthened, combed, trimmed, or grasped at the front of the head.
subchannels.active_motifs: combed long hair `ن ص ي:B002/m01`; trimming `ق ل م:B001/m03`; forelock `ن ص ي:B001/m02`; grasping the forelock `س ف ع:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Growth and combing describe care, trimming controls form, and grasping changes the groomed forelock into a point of domination. The surface punishment scene therefore touches a broader bodily-adornment system.

subchannels.name: Necklace, Neck, and Precious Attachment
subchannels.scene_or_process: A precious ornament is arranged around the neck and marks the wearer's status.
subchannels.active_motifs: necklace `ك ر م:B003/m01`; neck `ز ب ن:B008/m01`; precious attachment `ع ل ق:B007/m02`; public honor `ع ب د:B006/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: The neck supplies the support, the necklace supplies the object, attachment supplies fixation, and honor supplies the social meaning of wearing it.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Bodies and materials are covered, colored, worn, cut, marked, and ornamented so that surface appearance carries social meaning.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; the pen at 96:4, seeing and deceptive display at 96:7 and 96:13, and the forelock at 96:15-16 provide the surface hinges.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The channel joins bodices, dyed and iridescent cloth, fraying, recycled material, tattoo lines, combed hair, necklaces, and the neck itself.

parent_channels.name: Wildlife, Hunting, and Animal Movement

subchannels.name: Hunt, Trap, and Captured Prey
subchannels.scene_or_process: A hunter goes out, sets a fixed snare, and holds an animal that has become entangled.
subchannels.active_motifs: going out to hunt `س م و:B006/m01`; snared prey `ع ل ق:B011/m01`; fixed hunting trap `ص ل و:B004/m01`; quarry that runs then halts `ك ذ ب:B007/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: The hunt supplies the agent and purpose, the fixed trap supplies the mechanism, and entanglement supplies the capture outcome. The quarry's run and halt describe the movement interrupted by capture.

subchannels.name: Raptors, Shrikes, and Foraging
subchannels.scene_or_process: Predatory birds range over a food field and secure the subsistence on which they live.
subchannels.active_motifs: falcon or hawk `ع ل م:B006/m01`; shrike `و ق ي:B005/m01`; subsistence portion `ع ل ق:B006/m02`; fodder plant `ن ص ي:B004/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: The named birds supply agents, pasture supplies hunting terrain, and subsistence supplies the functional outcome. The channel is ecological rather than a simple list of species.

subchannels.name: Herd, Young Wild Animal, and Predator
subchannels.scene_or_process: Herd animals and their young occupy a field also traversed by a carnivorous predator.
subchannels.active_motifs: herd `ر ب ب:B014/m01`; young wild cow `ط غ و:B009/m01`; lamb `ء م ر:B009/m01`; male hyena `ع ل م:B007/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ر ب ب` 96:1, 96:3, 96:8; `ط غ و` has no separate surface token; `ء م ر` 96:12; `ع ل م` 96:4-5, 96:14
subchannels.synthesis: Herd and young animals supply vulnerable participants, while the hyena supplies the predator role. The scene places husbanded and wild life within one shared risk field.

subchannels.name: Chase, Halt, and Migration
subchannels.scene_or_process: An animal runs under pursuit, abruptly halts, or returns after seasonal movement.
subchannels.active_motifs: run then halt `ك ذ ب:B007/m01`; pursuit `س م و:B006/m02`; migrating birds returning `ر ج ع:B012/m01`; animal gait `ر ج ع:B008/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Pursuit supplies external pressure, the halt interrupts flight, and migration supplies a larger cycle of departure and return. Gait is the repeated bodily mechanism common to each movement.

subchannels.name: Horse Pace, Race Position, and Hoof Care
subchannels.scene_or_process: A horse advances at a controlled pace, occupies a place in a race, and adjusts movement around hoof pain.
subchannels.active_motifs: trotting approach `ق ر ب:B014/m01`; swift running `ع ب د:B009/m01`; second horse `ص ل و:B006/m01`; hoof protection `و ق ي:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Pace and speed determine race position, while hoof protection modifies movement to preserve the animal. The scene joins competitive order with the biomechanics that sustain it.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Animals are identified, pursued, trapped, nourished, bred, and tracked through characteristic motion.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; transgression at 96:6 carries a young wild-cow branch, denial at 96:13 carries an animal run-and-halt branch, and approach at 96:19 carries equine motion.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The channel contains snares, raptors, shrikes, hyenas, lambs, herds, migration, halted flight, racing order, and hoof care.

parent_channels.name: Measure, Allocation, and Exchange

subchannels.name: Lottery Vessel and Drawn Arrow
subchannels.scene_or_process: Prepared arrows are collected in a covered vessel and one is drawn to allocate an outcome.
subchannels.active_motifs: lot-arrow container `ر ب ب:B010/m01`; pared lot arrow `ق ل م:B004/m01`; polished shaft `خ ل ق:B008/m03`; vessel lid `ك ر م:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Paring and polishing prepare equivalent lots, the vessel conceals them, and the lid preserves uncertainty until selection. The apparatus converts crafted objects into a decision mechanism.

subchannels.name: Amount, Approximation, and Weight
subchannels.scene_or_process: A quantity is estimated, bounded, and expressed through a recognized unit of weight.
subchannels.active_motifs: estimation `خ ل ق:B001/m02`; approximate amount `ق ر ب:B016/m01`; numerical extent `ن ه ي:B010/m01`; ounce weight `و ق ي:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Estimation proposes a value, approximation admits a range, numerical extent sets a bound, and the ounce supplies a conventional standard.

subchannels.name: Resale, Return, and Replacement
subchannels.scene_or_process: A transferred good is returned, replaced, or sold onward at an assessed value.
subchannels.active_motifs: return or replacement in trade `ر ج ع:B011/m01`; resale `و ل ي:B014/m01`; approximate price `ق ر ب:B016/m02`; weight standard `و ق ي:B004/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Return reverses the first transfer, resale redirects the good to a new party, and approximation with weight supplies valuation for the renewed exchange.

subchannels.name: Territorial Partition and Boundary Marking
subchannels.scene_or_process: Land is measured, cut into a section, and made recognizable by a boundary mark.
subchannels.active_motifs: measured layout `خ ل ق:B001/m03`; cut tract of land `ق ل م:B008/m01`; guiding boundary mark `ع ل م:B002/m04`; place and station `ك و ن:B002/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Measurement establishes extent, cutting creates the tract, the mark distinguishes it, and place gives the partition a stable spatial identity.

subchannels.name: Image-Bearing Coin and Denomination
subchannels.scene_or_process: A struck image marks a coin whose value is related to a weight standard.
subchannels.active_motifs: image-bearing dirham `س ج د:B006/m01`; repeated engraving `ر ج ع:B009/m02`; ounce standard `و ق ي:B004/m03`; distinguishing sign `ع ل م:B002/m05`
subchannels.synthesis: The engraved image identifies the coin, repeated marking records the production operation, and the weight standard anchors denomination. Sign and value coincide on one portable object.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Goods, land, and chances are divided by counting, weighing, approximation, selection, and reciprocal transfer.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; the pen at 96:4 carries cutting and lot-arrow branches, return at 96:8 carries resale, and protective piety at 96:12 carries a weight-unit branch.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The channel includes lottery arrows, measured amounts, ounces, resale, image-bearing coins, and territorial sections.

parent_channels.name: Heat, Collapse, and Misfortune

subchannels.name: Controlled Heating and Preparation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Thick material is heated or roasted and may be ground into a prepared food or aromatic compound.
subchannels.active_motifs: thick syrup or paste `ر ب ب:B006/m01`; roasting heat `ص ل و:B001/m02`; grinding slab `ص ل و:B008/m01`; perfume mortar `ع ب د:B012/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Heat changes consistency, grinding reduces material, and the resulting paste or perfume is a controlled product. This is force used constructively.

subchannels.name: Scorch and Defensive Shelter
subchannels.scene_or_process: Fire or hot wind strikes the body or material, creating a need for protective enclosure.
subchannels.active_motifs: scorching blast `س ف ع:B003/m01`; exposure to fire `ص ل و:B001/m01`; self-protection `و ق ي:B002/m01`; blackened tinge `س ف ع:B002/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: The blast is the agent, exposure is the contact, darkening is the visible result, and shelter is the compensating response.

subchannels.name: Cascading Fall and Breakdown
subchannels.scene_or_process: One failing element pulls another down until an organized body or structure breaks apart.
subchannels.active_motifs: cascading collapse `د ع و:B005/m01`; breakdown and interruption `ع ب د:B011/m01`; succession `و ل ي:B002/m02`; cutting separation `ق ل م:B001/m04`
subchannels.synthesis: Succession turns an initial fall into a chain, breakdown names loss of function, and cutting completes separation. The process can describe either built structure or organized activity.

subchannels.name: Vicissitude, Doom, and Disgrace
subchannels.scene_or_process: Adverse events attach themselves to a person, culminate in calamity, and leave a public condition of shame.
subchannels.active_motifs: vicissitudes `د ع و:B006/m01`; attached calamity or doom `ع ل ق:B014/m01`; overwhelming punishment `ط غ و:B005/m01`; disgrace `ن د و:B005/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `د ع و` 96:17-18; `ع ل ق` 96:2; `ط غ و` has no separate surface token; `ن د و` 96:17
subchannels.synthesis: Vicissitude supplies repeated adversity, attachment makes the calamity inescapably personal, punishment supplies culmination, and disgrace supplies the social aftermath.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Material or circumstance is overtaken by force, producing controlled transformation, scorching, collapse, or calamity.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; prayer at 96:10 carries a fire branch, forelock seizure at 96:15 carries scorching and striking branches, and error at 96:16 opens the calamity sequence.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The channel contrasts cooking and aromatic preparation with destructive heat, cascading ruin, bodily breakdown, doom, and public disgrace.

parent_channels.name: Imaginal and Unseen Presence

subchannels.name: Dream Image
subchannels.scene_or_process: A sleeping perceiver receives a formed image that appears inwardly rather than as an external body.
subchannels.active_motifs: dream vision `ر ء ي:B003/m01`; human image in the dark pupil `ء ن س:B005/m02`; reflected appearance `ر ء ي:B006/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: Dream supplies the mode of perception, the pupil-image supplies an inward visual carrier, and reflected appearance gives the dream a coherent figure despite the absence of an external body.

subchannels.name: Spirit and Apparition
subchannels.scene_or_process: An unseen being or image becomes perceptible at the boundary between human presence and the nonhuman unseen.
subchannels.active_motifs: spirit or apparition `ر ء ي:B008/m01`; human contrasted with the unseen `ء ن س:B001/m02`; apparition-like pupil image `ء ن س:B005/m03`; misleading cultic power `ط غ ي:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The human/unseen contrast establishes the boundary, apparition crosses it as perceived presence, and the cultic-power motif shows how such presence can be elevated into a misleading authority.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A figure appears to perception without ordinary bodily presence, as dream image, reflection, spirit, or unseen counterpart.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; repeated seeing at 96:7-14 and repeated references to the human at 96:2, 96:5, and 96:6 supply the surface poles of appearance and embodiment.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The channel distinguishes the dream image inside perception from the spirit or apparition opposed to ordinary human visibility.

parent_channels.name: S1. Weapon Readied from Its Case
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A weapon is fitted with a point, kept in a case, and drawn by the hand for immediate use.
parent_channels.active_motifs: hand returning to the weapon `ر ج ع:B010/m01`; sword scabbard `ق ر ب:B010/m01`; fitted spearhead `ء م ر:B011/m01`; pared weapon tip `ق ل م:B005/m02`
parent_channels.synthesis: Paring and fitting prepare the point, the scabbard contains the weapon, and the returning hand changes stored readiness into deployment.

parent_channels.name: S2. Relational Grammar and Collectivity
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Particles and connective forms place entities at an endpoint or location, join them together, and construe them as a collective.
parent_channels.active_motifs: endpoint preposition `ء ل ي:B001/m02`; locative relation `ء ل ي:B002/m01`; particle of approximation or possibility `ر ب ب:B015/m01`; connective joining `ء ل ي:B003/m01`; plural connective `ء ل ي:B004/m01`; lexical gathering `ق ر ء:B001/m03`
parent_channels.synthesis: Endpoint and location establish grammatical relation, the modal particle qualifies assertion, and connective forms gather separate referents into one construed group.
